items.title: Eddie Morris Interview, 1958-12-21
items.q: I used to run all around to see Joe Oliver and, uh... Freddie Kepa.

ctx.x: Now, what about... Though, when you were a little boy, do you remember the names of any bands that were good then?

Well, I used to run all around to see Joe Oliver and, uh... Oh, man. Yeah, see Joe Oliver and, uh, Freddie Kepa. They used to pass on a little wagon, you know, there wasn't no trucks. Yeah. Then for the appetizer, they used to have them wagon and horse, and you could keep up with them and furniture wagging. You know, one time they used to have furniture wagging, you know, with the four wheels. Well, that's what they used to get the appetizer in. And you could keep up with them.
Did you get lost doing that?
